facts.fact: Four 不想在医院过夜，但 Shauna 说不答应就把她锁起来，他其实没有选择
facts.anchor: I don’t want to spend the night at the hospital, but Shauna threatens to lock me in

facts.fact: 氧气面罩的松紧带勒进他的头皮，口鼻周围的塑料让他觉得自己被困住
facts.anchor: the elastic of the oxygen mask is digging into my scalp

facts.fact: 他听出是 Evelyn 的脚步声：轻得不像护士，也不像医生
facts.anchor: The creep of her footsteps is too quiet for a nurse or a doctor

facts.fact: Evelyn 今天穿成 Amity 派的样子：红裙、披发，穿过医院不容易引人注意
facts.anchor: She’s dressed as an Amity today, in a red dress, her hair down

facts.fact: Evelyn 说 John——那个妹妹被他救下的人——把营救和替他对抗母亲的事都告诉了她
facts.anchor: that’s the man whose sister you saved

facts.fact: Evelyn 承认火是她放的，说她只想造够多的烟做掩护，火失控了
facts.anchor: my intention was only to create enough smoke for a diversion

facts.fact: Four 不确定母亲会不会为一杀一人而烧楼，只知道想相信不等于事实
facts.anchor: wanting to believe something doesn’t make it true

facts.fact: 她握住他的手、捏他的手指；他睁眼时人已经走了，门敞着
facts.anchor: I feel her hand on mine, squeezing my fingers
